This is my Jam!!
Apr 2022
I'm not a huge Mexican food guy being from the East Coast, it's readily available. But man, I'll put this up against any Mexican restaurant in all of HCMC. This is really authentic, and the food is delicious, Flavorful, vibrant, awesome! The head chef is from Mexico, so, you can't get much more authentic than that. Place also has a great vibe. After a long day of walking in D2, pop on over for a cold beer, or even better, a fantastic margarita. Music on the weekends. This place is ACES! A+. To me, sitting down, meeting new friends, this place just feels like home. Like I said, food is slamming good!! I have visited already a bunch of times, and this will be in the rotation every time I'm in HCMC.
Oh, I almost forgot. Try the Ceviche. The best I've had anywhere. I mean it! You will too! Get there, now!
